selection: Gaia DR3 stars brighter than G = 17 that are inside the picture on the date of at least one frame, brightest first. At most `limit` are returned; stars moving faster than 100 mas/yr are returned whatever the limit. n_in_field counts them before the cut. positions[i] is the star's place in frames[i]: ra, dec in degrees and x, y in PNG pixels from the top-left, on that frame's mean date.
bright_note: A very bright star is near: Gaia magnitude 5.1, 6.8 arcminutes from the centre of this view, outside the picture. Stars this bright can leave rings and streaks in SPHEREx images. They are reflections inside the telescope, the archive does not mark them, and they land in a different place in each visit. A ring or streak that moves between frames here is most likely one of those, not a change on the sky.
